summary: The layout is well-structured, but the open menubar dropdown exhibits noticeable kerning and word spacing artifacts across multiple menu items.

issues.title: Broken text spacing in menu items
issues.description: Several menu item labels contain irregular spacing within words, breaking legibility.
issues.evidence: Labels render as 'N ew sec ure note', 'N ew f older', 'Lock wh en id le', and 'De le te this vault...'.
issues.suggestion: Remove extraneous spaces or reset tracking and letter-spacing styles on MenubarItem text.
